name: Nerawareta Yuutousei - Migawari no Daishou
original_name: 狙われた優等生 身代わりの代償
source:
Kirimizu Aoi wasn't just a top student; she was also kind and compassionate, earning her the title of "model student" from both teachers and classmates. She held her childhood friend and classmate, Tsuchikasu Kenta, in high regard.

To save this friend, who was misunderstood as cheating on a retake, Aoi desperately pleaded with the teacher in charge of the exam, but was told to discuss it at home. Although she hesitated to go to a single man's apartment, her desire to help her dear friend pushed her to follow him to his place.

At that moment, Aoi had no idea that the teacher before her harbored strong sexual desires for her...

[Translated from the [url=https://syrup-soft.com/mm/yutosei/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
桐水葵不仅是一名尖子生，还是一名优等生。她性格善良、富有同情心，被老师和同学评为“模范学生”。她非常尊重儿时好友兼同学土鹤健太。

为了挽救这位被误会重考作弊的朋友，葵拼命向负责考试的老师求情，却被告知要在家讨论。尽管她犹豫是否要去单身男人的公寓，但帮助她亲爱的朋友的愿望促使她跟随他去了他的住处。

那一刻，葵并不知道眼前的老师对她有着强烈的性欲……
